CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild thrombocytopenia, elevated basophils, mildly increased creatinine, high albumin, and elevated alkaline phosphatase. Other hematological and biochemical parameters are within normal limits. The findings suggest possible respiratory compromise and mild renal and hepatic involvement; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
